mechanics.gameplaymod.tarzan_rope.summar: A rope with an anchor: grab the end and swing on it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.tarzan_rope.use.1: RMB on a block, raft, balloon or creature — the rope is anchored there and the other end stays in your hand.
mechanics.gameplaymod.tarzan_rope.contro: %1$s — lengthen the rope, %2$s — shorten it (creative mode).
RMB with the end in hand — let go; LMB on the rope — grab it again.
Shift — climb down the rope (you can't climb up this way).
Ctrl+RMB on a block or raft — hook the free end there.
mechanics.gameplaymod.tarzan_rope.traits: In survival and adventure the tarzan length can't be changed; in creative it can: 0.2 to 24 blocks.
mechanics.gameplaymod.calm_rope.summary: A no-swing tarzan: longer than the usual one, but you can hardly swing sideways.
mechanics.gameplaymod.calm_rope.use.1: RMB on a block, raft, balloon or creature — the rope is anchored there and the other end stays in your hand.
mechanics.gameplaymod.calm_rope.controls: %1$s — lengthen the rope, %2$s — shorten it (creative mode).
RMB with the end in hand — let go; LMB on the rope — grab it again.
Shift — climb down the rope (you can't climb up this way).
Ctrl+RMB on a block or raft — hook the free end there.
mechanics.gameplaymod.calm_rope.traits.1: Swing is limited: the holder can't get farther than 2 blocks from the plumb line under the anchor.
mechanics.gameplaymod.calm_rope.traits.2: In survival and adventure the length is preset and can't be changed.
mechanics.gameplaymod.pull_rope.summary: A short rope for pulling: from 0.2 blocks.
mechanics.gameplaymod.pull_rope.use.1: RMB on a block, raft, balloon or creature — the rope is anchored there and the other end stays in your hand.
mechanics.gameplaymod.pull_rope.controls: RMB with the end in hand — let go; LMB on the rope — grab it again.
Shift — climb down the rope (you can't climb up this way).
Ctrl+RMB on a block or raft — hook the free end there.
mechanics.gameplaymod.pull_rope.traits.1: While the rope is held the character passes through other creatures; if it ends up inside a block or a creature it is pushed to the nearest free spot.
mechanics.gameplaymod.pull_rope.traits.2: A rope anchored to a block can only be shortened in survival.
mechanics.gameplaymod.current_marker.sum: Current marker: sets where rafts and logs are carried by this water.
mechanics.gameplaymod.current_marker.use: RMB on water — place the marker in the water cell you aim at: the current flows the way you face.
mechanics.gameplaymod.current_marker.con: RMB on a placed marker — turn it by 30°.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it (the item comes back).
mechanics.gameplaymod.current_marker.tra: The marker is visible only while you hold the item.
A raft without a current under it stays put.
mechanics.gameplaymod.raft_binder.summar: Raft binder: gathers a build into a raft that the current carries.
mechanics.gameplaymod.raft_binder.use.1: RMB on a block — the whole connected build is gathered into a raft.
mechanics.gameplaymod.raft_binder.use.2: RMB on a raft — take it apart back into blocks.
mechanics.gameplaymod.raft_binder.use.3: The current comes from current markers in the water under the raft.
mechanics.gameplaymod.raft_binder.traits: Terrain doesn't go into the raft — only the build.
A raft can't contain blocks with contents (chests etc.).
Too big a build can't be gathered into a raft.
mechanics.gameplaymod.balloon_burner.use: RMB on a block — the whole connected build is gathered into a balloon.
RMB on a balloon — take it apart back into blocks.
Then the balloon is steered by the lift and helm ropes hung on it.
Lift rope: the mouse wheel raises and lowers the balloon.
RMB on a balloon — hang the rope on it, the other end stays in your hand.
While holding the rope, RMB with coal or other furnace fuel — refuel it.
Mouse wheel: forward — balloon up one block, back — down.
RMB — let go of the rope, LMB on it — grab it again.
Each wheel click spends one unit of fuel; an empty rope doesn't steer the balloon.
Up to 256 units (coal gives 16). The rest is shown on the item bar and above the hotbar.
Helm rope: the mouse wheel pushes the balloon forward-back or right-left.
RMB on a balloon — hang the rope on it, the other end stays in your hand.
While holding the rope, RMB with coal or other furnace fuel — refuel it.
Mouse wheel: forward — push the balloon forward (or right), back — back (or left).
%3$s — switch the wheel axis: forward-back or right-left.
RMB — let go of the rope, LMB on it — grab it again.
Each wheel click spends one unit of fuel; an empty rope doesn't steer the balloon.
“Forward” is counted from the player's view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.wind_marker.summar: Wind marker: sets where the wind blows here and how it acts on a balloon.
mechanics.gameplaymod.wind_marker.use.1: RMB — place the marker in the air, next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view; the arrow points the way you face.
mechanics.gameplaymod.wind_marker.contro: RMB on a marker — turn it around the vertical by 30°.
Ctrl+RMB — tilt up by 30°, Ctrl+LMB — down (up to vertical).
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.wind_marker.traits: The wind weakens towards the edge of the marker's area.
The marker is visible only while you hold the item.
mechanics.gameplaymod.barrage_marker.use: RMB — place the marker next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.launcher_marker.us: RMB — place the marker next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.smoke_marker.use.1: RMB — place the marker next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.lava_wave_marker.u: RMB — place the marker next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.glasses.use.1: Open the character window with the inventory key and put the glasses in the “Eyes” slot.
mechanics.gameplaymod.barrage_marker.sum: Barrage: while a player is near the marker, arrows appear around them and fly to where they stand.
mechanics.gameplaymod.barrage_marker.con: RMB on a marker — turn the course; Ctrl+RMB / Ctrl+LMB — arrows appear farther / closer.
The course and distance are shown above the hotbar.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.barrage_marker.tra: Arrows fly only while the player stands, slows down or goes back; a player running along the marker's course isn't shot at all.
Only the marker nearest to the player shoots at them: route sections replace each other.
Turned on and off by the level mechanic “Arrows” (by the marker's group); a marker without a group always fires.
mechanics.gameplaymod.deadzone_marker.su: Dead zone: a box where a player standing on its blocks is hit by arrows from all sides.
mechanics.gameplaymod.deadzone_marker.us: RMB — place the marker next to the block you aim at or 3 blocks along your view.
mechanics.gameplaymod.deadzone_marker.co: RMB on a marker — the next horizontal size; Ctrl+RMB / Ctrl+LMB — taller / shorter.
The size is shown above the hotbar.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.deadzone_marker.tr: Air isn't part of the zone: a player is inside only when standing on a block of the box or being in it (water, grass).
This is how route boundaries are made: shooting around the corridor scares off, so don't step past its edge.
The zone is visible only while you hold the item.
mechanics.gameplaymod.launcher_marker.su: Launcher: a marker on a block that throws characters in an arc.
mechanics.gameplaymod.launcher_marker.co: Ctrl+RMB / Ctrl+LMB — distance longer / shorter by a step.
Shift+RMB / Shift+LMB — height higher / lower by a step.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.launcher_marker.tr: Whoever steps into the cell above the block flies along the course to the set distance and lands without fall damage.
The launcher constantly emits a little smoke.
mechanics.gameplaymod.smoke_marker.summa: Smoke: a column of thick smoke going up from the marker. Visual only — it doesn't affect players or blocks.
mechanics.gameplaymod.smoke_marker.contr: RMB on a marker — the next radius; Ctrl+RMB / Ctrl+LMB — taller / shorter by 2 blocks.
The radius, height and puffs per second are shown above the hotbar.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.smoke_marker.trait: Columns stacked on top of each other merge into one smoke.
mechanics.gameplaymod.lava_wave_marker.s: Lava wave: a marker on the shore of a lava lake; a wave runs from it along the course.
mechanics.gameplaymod.lava_wave_marker.c: RMB on a marker — course +30°; Ctrl+RMB / Ctrl+LMB — wave path longer / shorter by 2 blocks.
The course, path, crest and lava limit are shown above the hotbar.
LMB on a marker with the item — remove it.
mechanics.gameplaymod.lava_wave_marker.t: After its path the wave crashes and raises the lake's lava by a layer while the top of the lava is below the limit.
Inside the wave the body burns as in lava.
A marker with a group starts the wave through the level mechanic “Lava wave” and reports its end.
mechanics.gameplaymod.balloon_burner.sum: Balloon burner: gathers a build into a hot-air balloon.
mechanics.gameplaymod.balloon_burner.tra: The player sets the balloon's height with the lift rope; wind (wind markers) and helm pushes carry it sideways.
A balloon standing on the ground isn't carried away.
Without fuel in the ropes the balloon lands by itself.
Like a raft, a balloon doesn't take terrain or blocks with contents.
mechanics.gameplaymod.glasses.summary: Glasses: character gear, worn in the “Eyes” slot.
mechanics.gameplaymod.glasses.traits.1: Level tasks can check that the glasses are worn.
mechanics.gameplaymod.krosh_tailed_spawn: Spawn egg: moves the character to the clicked spot — Krosh.
RMB on a block — the character appears there; if it's already in the world it is moved here: there is only one of each.
In survival the egg is spent only if the summoning worked.
A busy character (a player or a script is in it) can't be moved — a message appears above the hotbar.
